title: Thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure: stress linearisation through the wall (ASME VIII-2 Annex 5-A on Lamé's solution)
source: Lamé's solution (Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill 1970, §28) with A₀ = p a² / (b² − a²) = 33.333, B₀ = A₀ b² = 13 333.3, σ_θ = A₀ + B₀/r², σ_r = A₀ − B₀/r², σ_z = 2νA₀, integrated in closed form over the wall by the membrane and bending definitions of ASME BPVC Section VIII Division 2, Annex 5-A (5-A.4.1): hoop membrane p a/(b − a), hoop bending at the bore (6 B₀/t²)[c (1/a − 1/b) − ln(b/a)], c = (a + b)/2, peaks as total less membrane and bending, radial membrane −p a/(a + b)

quantities.quantity: hoop membrane stress σᵐ_θ = p a / (b − a) along the radial line from the bore (10, 0, 0.5) to the outside (20, 0, 0.5)
quantities.reason: 8 × 16 hex20 mesh, each element's own extrapolated nodal stresses integrated with Simpson's rule on 41 points: the integrals are within 0.1% of the closed forms

quantities.quantity: hoop bending stress at the bore, (6 B₀ / t²) [c (1/a − 1/b) − ln(b/a)] with c = (a + b)/2
quantities.reason: 8 × 16 hex20 mesh, each element's own extrapolated nodal stresses integrated with Simpson's rule on 41 points: the integrals are within 0.1% of the closed forms

quantities.quantity: hoop peak stress at the bore, σ_θ(a) − σᵐ_θ − σᵇ_θ
quantities.reason: the peak is the small difference of the surface stress and the membrane and bending parts, each 0.2 to 0.4% off on this 8 × 16 hex20 mesh (0.3, 0.23 and 0.18 in stress units): added up, 3.4% of the 21.2 peak at the bore; 16 radial divisions bring it under 1%

quantities.quantity: hoop peak stress outside, σ_θ(b) − σᵐ_θ + σᵇ_θ
quantities.reason: the peak is the small difference of the surface stress and the membrane and bending parts, each 0.2 to 0.4% off on this 8 × 16 hex20 mesh (0.3, 0.23 and 0.18 in stress units): added up, 3.4% of the 21.2 peak at the bore; 16 radial divisions bring it under 1%

quantities.quantity: radial membrane stress σᵐ_r = −p a / (a + b)
quantities.reason: 8 × 16 hex20 mesh, each element's own extrapolated nodal stresses integrated with Simpson's rule on 41 points: the integrals are within 0.1% of the closed forms

quantities.quantity: axial membrane stress σᵐ_z = 2 ν A₀ (plane strain)
quantities.reason: 8 × 16 hex20 mesh, each element's own extrapolated nodal stresses integrated with Simpson's rule on 41 points: the integrals are within 0.1% of the closed forms

quantities.quantity: von Mises stress of the membrane tensor (σᵐ_r, σᵐ_θ, σᵐ_z)
quantities.reason: 8 × 16 hex20 mesh, each element's own extrapolated nodal stresses integrated with Simpson's rule on 41 points: the integrals are within 0.1% of the closed forms
